note: Every hash is a real testnet deploy, and every result here was read back from the node rather than asserted. The first block is the v2 install (13 entry points, underwriter bond custody), driven end to end through the web UI with a browser wallet. The refusals that follow were executed against the v1 install and are kept because a rejection code is evidence regardless of which install produced it.

steps.name: post_bond (10 CSPR staked, the contract minimum)
steps.proves: the bond is custody, not a table entry: payable, so real CSPR moved into the contract's purse

steps.name: open_note (risk 82 >= min 50, underwriter bonded)
steps.proves: the agent's proposal became a note only after the owner signed it, and only while bonded

steps.name: fund_note (15 CSPR, the exact face value)
steps.proves: the investor's CSPR was forwarded to the seller by the escrow

steps.name: mark_repaid (debtor settled off chain)
steps.proves: the lifecycle closes: note 1 reads Repaid

steps.name: open_note (second note, for the default path)
steps.proves: note ids are found by scanning chain state, so a second note does not collide

steps.name: fund_note (15 CSPR against note 2)
steps.proves: a second investor position exists to be made whole

steps.name: declare_default (bond slashed to the investor, capped at the stake)
steps.proves: the 10 CSPR stake paid the investor of a 15 CSPR note: the payout is capped and the shortfall is visible, and the contract now reports defaults 1

steps.name: open_note (accepted, risk 80 >= min 50)
steps.proves: the happy path executes, so the reverts below are refusals and not a dead contract

steps.name: open_note (risk 10 < min 50)
steps.proves: the acceptance bar lives on chain: the agent cannot underwrite below it

steps.name: open_note (duplicate id)
steps.proves: a receivable cannot be financed twice under one id

steps.name: fund_note (no such note)
steps.proves: funds cannot be sent to an invented note id

steps.name: fund_note (0.5 CSPR against a 1 CSPR note)
steps.proves: a partially funded note is refused rather than half-settled

steps.name: mark_repaid (note still open)
steps.proves: the lifecycle cannot skip funding: open -> funded -> repaid is enforced

steps.name: fund_note (exact amount)
steps.proves: an exactly funded note settles and forwards CSPR to the seller

steps.name: mark_repaid (after funding)
steps.proves: the full lifecycle completes on chain
